name: shifting-mirage-tristan-bonus-shadow-stealth-opponent-declines
notes: Shifting Mirage (hmjr33ijq6, UMBRA REACTION action): "[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate. Your champion gains stealth until end of turn unless an opponent pays (2). [Tristan Bonus] Summon an Ominous Shadow token." Player 1's champion is patched to Tristan, Shadowdancer so UMBRA, the Class Bonus and the Tristan Bonus are all active. The card is played for real; ShiftingMirageResolve() (Custom/GameLogic.php) queues a YES/NO for the opponent (who holds 7+ cards) and, regardless of the answer, summons the Ominous Shadow for the Tristan Bonus. ENGINE BUGS: (1) (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed) Double Class-Bonus discount: the card needs only ONE reserve payment although printed 3 minus the Class Bonus should be 2 (two independent discount mechanisms both apply; confirmed by calling ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers / ClassBonusActivateCostReduction / CalculateActivationReserveCost directly on this fixture's initial state: 2 / 1 / 1). (2) (FIXED) Wrong champion got stealth: when the opponent declines, customDQHandlers["ShiftingMiragePay"] (Custom/CardDQHandlers.php) runs in the OPPONENT's action but the champion mzID was stored relative to player 1 ("myField-0"), which resolved to the OPPONENT's champion (trace: handlerPlayer=2 storedChampMZ=myField-0 resolvesTo=pNiyaGlIe7 controller=2). ShiftingMirageResolve() now stores it relative to the opponent (NormalizeMzIDForController), so the CASTER's champion gains STEALTH and the opponent's gains nothing. Defect (1) is still pinned with a REGRESSION GUARD assertion.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate.
Your champion gains stealth until end of turn unless an opponent pays (2).
[Tristan Bonus] Summon an Ominous Shadow token.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. When the opponent declines to pay (2), Shifting Mirage's STEALTH used to land on the OPPONENT's champion: ShiftingMirageResolve() stored the caster-relative mzID 'myField-0' in DecisionQueueController variable ShiftingMirageChampion, and customDQHandlers['ShiftingMiragePay'] later applied AddTurnEffect() from inside the opponent's own action, where 'myField-0' resolves to the opponent's champion (live trace on HEAD before the fix: handlerPlayer=2 globalPlayerID=2 storedChampMZ=myField-0 resolvesTo=pNiyaGlIe7 controller=2). Fix: the champion mzID is now stored relative to the opponent via NormalizeMzIDForController() and read back through NormalizeMZForPlayerPerspective($player, ...) in the handler (the stored-mzID convention documented above NormalizeMzIDForController() in Custom/OpportunityLogic.php). The YES branch (opponent pays) never read the stored value. The separate double Class-Bonus discount defect (see the sibling shifting-mirage-tristan-bonus-shadow-stealth-opponent-pays fixture) is NOT part of this fix and is still pinned.

additionalEngineBugs.summary: Shifting Mirage's printed '[Class Bonus] This card costs 1 less to activate' is applied TWICE: once by the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['hmjr33ijq6:0'] (via ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers) and once more by the hand-maintained ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() table (which still lists hmjr33ijq6). With the Class Bonus active, printed reserve 3 becomes 1 instead of 2. Confirmed live by calling the engine's own cost functions on the fixture's initial state: ApplyGeneratedReserveLikeCostModifiers(...,3,'activate') = 2, ClassBonusActivateCostReduction('hmjr33ijq6') = 1, CalculateActivationReserveCost() = 1.
additionalEngineBugs.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php CalculateActivationReserveCost() (~line 26207) applying ClassBonusActivateCostReduction() on top of the generated activationCostModifierAbilities['hmjr33ijq6:0'] discount.
